FIND: In `MacrophageCell._patrol_observe`, the timing spike detection uses `median_t > 0.1` as a gate for flagging spikes. Because 0.1 is not exactly representable in binary floating-point, the comparison is unreliable: a median computed from values that mathematically equal 0.1 may compare strictly greater or less depending on floating‑point error, causing inconsistent detection. This is a correctness defect — the code intends to skip spike detection when absolute timings are negligible, but the threshold is fragile.

FOLLOW: If the threshold erroneously evaluates False, genuine timing spikes (stages taking >3× the median) are silently not flagged even when they should be. If it erroneously evaluates True, borderline medians may flag insignificant spikes. Both cause the Macrophage to misreport pipeline health, degrading the value of the immune monitoring system.

ANALYSE: HARD — the comparison is deterministic but the intent is to avoid false positives at very small time scales; the unreliability means the code does not reliably implement its own specification. CONFIRMED.
